SPORTS AND RECREATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: SPORTS AND RECREATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Management of Sports Activities: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Management of Sports Activities with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Management of Sports Activities.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Management of Sports Activities.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Management of Sports Activities.

2. Best practice when working on Basic Elements of Sports Coaching: (1 mark)

   D. Practise Basic Elements of Sports Coaching with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation.
   C. Practise Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation.

4. Best practice when working on Injuries in Sports and Recreation ● Management of some common injuries (controll: (1 mark)

   B. Refuse all feedback on Injuries in Sports and Recreation ● Management of some common injuries (controll.
   C. Damage equipment used for Injuries in Sports and Recreation ● Management of some common injuries (controll.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Injuries in Sports and Recreation ● Management of some common injuries (controll.

5. Best practice when working on Principles of training Specificity Overload and Progression: (1 mark)

6. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Green, orange, and purple

7. Best practice when working on Officiating Games III: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Officiating Games III.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Officiating Games III.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Officiating Games III.
   D. Practise Officiating Games III with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume

10. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Replace drinking water

11. Best practice when working on Team management ● Role of team manager (planning, Communication, Coordination, W: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Management of Sports Activities and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Team management ● Role of team manager (planning, Communication, Coordination, W and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Tactical Skills and Formations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Talent Exposure and Monetization Talent exposure and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Practise Management of Sports Activities with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. D — Practise Basic Elements of Sports Coaching with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. C — Practise Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. A — Practise Injuries in Sports and Recreation ● Management of some common injuries (controll with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. A — Practise Principles of training Specificity Overload and Progression with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. A — Red, blue, and yellow

7. D — Practise Officiating Games III with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. A — The speed of the music

9. C — Practise Game officials with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. B — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

11. B — Practise Team management ● Role of team manager (planning, Communication, Coordination, W with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. A — Practise Talent Exposure and Monetization Talent exposure with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Management of Sports Activities; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Team management ● Role of team manager (planning, Communication, Coordination, W; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Tactical Skills and Formations; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Talent Exposure and Monetization Talent exposure; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
